newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises local oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises local oil prices.

text.p: The government's Energy Regulatory Board (ERB) said on Wednesday oil prices will be raised by an average of 32 centavos per liter.
The price adjustments will take effect at 6 a.m on Thursday (2200 GMT Wednesday).

ERB Chairman Bayani Faylona said the price of diesel oil will be raised by 50 centavos to 7.57 pesos a litre while the price of aviation turbo will be increased by 41 centavos to 9.4349 pesos per litre.

Of the three gasoline products, only unleaded gasoline remained unchanged at 10.25 pesos. Premium gasoline will be raised by one centavo to 10.26 pesos while regular gasoline will be hiked by 4.8 centavos to 9.49 pesos.
Fuel oil price will be raised by 39.5 centavos to 3.93 pesos.
The price of liquefied petroleum gasoline will increase by 11.13 centavos to 5.95 per litre. Kerosene prices will be raised by 35 centavos to 6.95 pesos a litre.
Faylona said most of the prices of oil products were raised due to increased Singapore posted prices.
This is the third time since August that the government has raised petroleum prices as part of the partial deregulation of the oil industry.
The ERB adjusts oil prices on a monthly basis using an automatic formula that is based on Singapore posted prices.
